name: University of Bonn
description: The Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn is a public research university in Bonn, North Rhine-Westphalia, founded in 1818. It has around 35,000 students and is one of Germany's universities of excellence.
whyIncluded: The University of Bonn is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (about 6,600 international students, 19% of 34,652, per a 2026 aggregator figure), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Bonn's own 'Costs' page lists average monthly student spending in Bonn: rent, food, transport, and a personal line covering health costs, phone, leisure, study materials and clothing. Excludes the semester fee, which includes the Deutschland semester ticket.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. University of Bonn 'Costs' page, table 'Living expenses' ('Average monthly living expenses in Bonn total:'), which the page attributes to the 22nd DSW/DZHW Social Survey (2023). Lines used verbatim: Rent 410, Food 198, Transportation (car) 89, Health care costs 100, Communication 31, Leisure 65, Learning material 31, Clothing 46. Derivation: housing = 410; food = 198; transport = 89 (the page's own transport line; note most students actually travel on the Deutschlandsemesterticket inside the semester fee); personal = 100 + 31 + 65 + 31 + 46 = 273. Monthly total 970. Excluded: semester fee / social contribution EUR 363.07 for winter 2026/27 (of which Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80) and 345.07 for summer 2026. The page gives no separate health-insurance premium; the 'Health care costs' line is the only health item. The international-students page ('Costs and Financing for International Students') gives only a single total of roughly EUR 1,000/month and the EUR 992/month visa proof-of-funds figure, consistent with this table.

programmes.name: Informatik (Computer Science) B.Sc.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket. Taught in German.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: the University of Bonn's 'Costs' page states that as a public university it does not charge tuition (North Rhine-Westphalia charges none, including for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = semester contribution for winter semester 2026/27, stated total EUR 363.07 x2 = 726.14. Items listed: student self-administration 14.00, social services 0.50, student councils 2.25, support fund 0.01, university sports 0.80, culture pass 3.00, Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80, mobility refund account 0.01, Studierendenwerk 115.00; these sum to 362.37, EUR 0.70 below the stated total (re-read 2026-10-07; the stated total is used). 2025 history: the same page gives summer semester 2026 (part of academic year 2025/26) as EUR 345.07, identical except the ticket at 208.80, so 690.14; the winter 2025/26 rate is not published there, so the summer rate x2 is used (as for HU Berlin). No 2024 figure found (Bonn's 2024 finance flyer only says 'ca. 345 EUR'). Language of instruction German: the Institute of Computer Science's bachelor's page says 'All the Bachelor programs are offered in German' (informatik.uni-bonn.de/en/studies/bachelor-programs). Standard period 6 semesters (usual Bonn B.Sc.; not read from the programme page).
